title: Security
changeFailed: Could not change your password. Check your current password and try again.
confirmLogoutAll: This will sign you out on every device, including this one. Continue?
exportDataDesc: Download your account, bookings, reviews and notifications as a JSON file.
notificationPreferencesDesc: Choose which notifications you want to receive.
twoFactorDesc: Require a 6-digit code from an authenticator app at every login. Available for administrator accounts.
twoFactorStep1: Scan this QR code with Google Authenticator, 1Password, or any TOTP app.
twoFactorStep2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows to confirm enrolment.
twoFactorSecretOnce: Shown only once — it cannot be retrieved again.
twoFactorDisableHint: Enter a current code from your authenticator app to turn 2FA off.
noSessionsDesc: This is the only device signed in to your account.
